Create a comprehensive, AI-powered web application called "PrepAI" designed for students in India preparing for competitive exams like IIT JEE, NEET, and board exams (CBSE/ICSE). .
1. Core Structure & Layout:
Authentication: Implement separate pages for Login, Signup, and Password Reset. Hardcode an admin user with the credentials email: vk16122001@gmail.com, password: Vijay@147896.
Main Layout: After login, the app should have a main layout with a collapsible sidebar for navigation on the left and a header at the top. The central area will render the active page content.
2. Application Pages & Features:
Dashboard:
Display a welcome message.
Include "Action Cards" to navigate to the "Q-Bank Generator" and "Analytics" pages.
Show a static leaderboard and a "Your Badges" section to create an engaging UI.
Add a prominent call-to-action button for starting a "Quick Test."
Q-Bank Generator (Core Feature):
Provide dropdowns for selecting Exam, Subject, Chapter, and Topic. These should be dynamically populated from a file containing a comprehensive nested object of all syllabi.
Include an input for the Number of Questions.
On clicking "Generate," use the Gemini API (gemini 2.5 pro) to perform two tasks in a single call:
Generate the requested number of high-quality, mixed-type (MCQ, Fill in the Blanks, etc.) questions for the selected topic.
Provide a priority list of the most important topics for the selected subject and exam.
Display the generated questions in individual QuestionCard components, which should allow users to select an answer, reveal the correct answer and explanation, and see visual feedback (e.g., green for correct, red for incorrect).
On a correct answer, show a brief "+10 PTS" animation.
Each question card should have a button to "Suggest Video for [Topic]," which calls the Gemini API with Google Search grounding to find and display a relevant YouTube video in a VideoCard.
Display the prioritized topics in a sticky sidebar.
Implement filtering controls for the generated questions based on difficulty, type, and topic.
Include a "View Notes for [Topic]" button that navigates the user to the Study Materials page with the current context.
Study Materials Page:
Allow users to manually select an Exam, Subject, Chapter, and Topic to fetch study materials.
Use the Gemini API with Google Search grounding to generate comprehensive, easy-to-understand study notes for the selected topic.
The notes should be returned as a Markdown string. Create a MarkdownRenderer component that can parse and style this markdown, including special formatting for hints like **[Key Concept]**, **[Memorize this formula]**, and **[Pro Tip]**.
AI Doubt Solver Page:
Create a chat interface for students to ask questions.
Use the Gemini chat API. Initialize the chat with a detailed system instruction that defines its persona: "PrepAI, a super friendly, cheerful, and creative AI tutor..." It must use emojis, markdown, and a fun tone.
The system prompt must include a critical rule: If the question is outside the defined syllabus, the AI must politely refuse to answer and instead provide a fun, unrelated science or math fact.
Performance Analytics & Profile Pages:
Analytics: Create a static page displaying mock performance data with stat cards, progress bars for "Topic Mastery," and a bar chart for "Weekly Performance."
Profile: Allow users to view and edit their name, target exam, current class, and subjects.
Admin Page:
This page should only be accessible to the hardcoded admin user.
Display a dashboard with mock statistics (Total Users, Active Today, etc.).
Include a "User Management" table that lists mock users. This table must have a feature to reveal/hide each user's password.
